scope: Local non-author static source review of supervision work ledger, owner SSE, notification delivery, frontend client/panel/context and final HTTP5xx/detail-refresh deltas

findings.problem: An invalid or revoked member cookie could fall back to a separate valid administrator cookie, including the notification route carrying the new private supervision briefs.
findings.fix: Both route-local principal helpers disable administrator fallback whenever a member cookie is present.

findings.problem: SSE session revocation did not immediately invalidate frontend state; notification refresh could reuse a pending pre-revocation request.
findings.fix: Current-stream session-expired closes and clears streams and emits auth-required to invalidate private epochs. Late old-stream expiry is ignored. Notification change handling queues a fresh read after the previous flight.

findings.problem: HTTP500/502/503 was treated as a definitive non-commit, allowing changed content to receive a new command ID after a possibly committed create.
findings.fix: Only explicit rejection statuses clear uncertainty. Other failures retain the exact body and command ID, and changed content is blocked while the receipt remains unknown.

findings.problem: An initial replay could close before heartbeat assignment and still leave a newly created interval.
findings.fix: Heartbeat is created only while the stream remains open.

findings.problem: Durable replay used the latest task status with an older source event time and could present historical execution events as completed briefs.
findings.fix: Replayed execution notices use the persisted event type and a generic execution-update label. Current execution facts remain separately projected.

findings.problem: A newer overview invalidated an expanded cached detail without reloading it; a first old detail response arriving after an overview update had the same gap.
findings.fix: The effect watches overview and details, reloading stale loaded details. Detail requests are deduplicated by epoch/item/revision and late responses cannot lower the stored detail revision.
findings.runtimeVerification: Not run by this reviewer; fresh browser verification remains separate.

checked: Owner/current-principal checks precede work reads, writes and SSE access; SSE payload carries metadata without titles or brief bodies.
One owner EventSource is shared by context and project panels; cursor reads stay owner-bound and reconnects trigger authoritative reads.
Work revision, command receipt and event outbox share a transaction; expectedVersion enforces CAS and command fingerprints reject different-body reuse.
Notification IDs are deterministic per owner and immutable source event, making replay after the cross-database crash boundary idempotent.
Known private path segments and exact credential basenames are refused. Evidence references are neither opened nor declared verified.
Work-item completion remains separate from independent product acceptance. The ledger does not dispatch tasks or alter original objective counts.

authorEvidenceSummary.api: Six new unique groups each have a passing cut. The initial five-group cut retained 2 pass / 3 fail; only the failed three were rerun after correction, plus one new owner-stream group. No single all-six passing run is claimed.
authorEvidenceSummary.frontend: The original two new groups passed once; the final HTTP5xx correction added one targeted pure submission lifecycle group that passed once without rerunning the original two.
